{{Quote|Nouland flare. They're used some places to smoke out intruders.''"<br />"''Quite literally, I see.''"<br />"''Exactly. Nonsentient, not really dangerous, but big and scary and very flammable. Must have been installed sometime after Marcross stopped coming here.|Emperor's Hand Mara Jade Skywalker and Daric LaRone|<ref name="Allegiance" />}}
'''Nouland flares''' were nonsentient vines that were used to guard certain restricted areas. They were not very dangerous. They were threatening-looking, flammable, and would burn when hit with a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] bolt.

[[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Barshnis Choard|Choard's]] [[Shelkonwa governor's palace|estate]] on [[Shelkonwa]] had a number of Nouland flares growing on the property.<ref name="Allegiance" />

==Behind the scenes==
Nouland flare first appeared in [[Timothy Zahn]]'s [[2007]] novel [[Allegiance (novel)|''Allegiance'']].<ref name="Allegiance" />
